Estimated served items:
- 2 fried eggs: about 180 kcal (14 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat)
- Mushrooms, sautéed: about 50 kcal (3 g protein, 3 g carbs, 3 g fat)
- 1 slice thick white toast: about 100 kcal (3 g protein, 19 g carbs, 1 g fat)
- Butter portion, 7–10 g: about 60 kcal (7 g fat)
- Latte-type coffee with milk: about 80 kcal (5 g protein, 7 g carbs, 4 g fat)

That gives about 470 kcal served.

In the second photo, the plates are nearly empty, with only a few egg yolk traces left. The butter portion appears mostly uneaten, perhaps with a little used, and the coffee is mostly finished. I estimate leftovers at about 55 kcal: roughly 50 kcal of butter and 5 kcal of coffee and egg residue.

Eaten is about 415 kcal. Since the butter was mostly not eaten, the eaten fat is the served fat minus about 6 g of butter fat.

Totals served: protein 25 g, carbs 30 g, fat 29 g. Eaten: protein about 25 g, carbs about 29 g, fat about 23 g.
